headline: TREVOR LAWRENCE BEAT TWO TEAMS WITHOUT PLAYING FOR EITHER 🤡

sections.heading: THE TREVOR LAWRENCE CINEMATIC UNIVERSE 🎬
sections.body:
Set the scene. September 8, ChunckyM decides Trevor Lawrence is dead weight and drops him — for Cameron Dicker. A kicker. Six hours later Keeneng scoops Lawrence off waivers for a $0 bid, cutting Jordan Love to make room. Free quarterback, zero cost, beautiful piece of business. LOL.

Then Sunday came and Keeneng started Matthew Stafford. 4.1 points. Trevor Lawrence sat on the bench and threw for 34.1. Keeneng lost by 12.65. Do that math slowly: the man went to the trouble of claiming a quarterback, dropped a different quarterback to fit him, and then played neither of them. That's not a lineup decision, that's a hostage situation. 😭

And the punchline? ChunckyM lost too, by 9.25, with Cameron Dicker putting up a rousing 2.0. Two managers, one quarterback, zero wins. Lawrence didn't even suit up for this league and he's 2-0 against it. 🏆

sections.heading: TOP PERFORMERS (WHO MOSTLY LOST, LOL) 🔥
sections.body:
Caleb Williams put up 41.3 for muahuavang, the single best score in the league by a mile — and Ulysseus lost by 26.28. Josh Allen went 39.7 for ChunckyM. Lost. Derrick Henry hammered out 34.8 for Keeneng. Lost. The four biggest individual performances of Week 1 all belong to teams sitting at 0-1. Fantasy football, ladies and gentlemen. 🙄

The guys who actually got paid: Jaxson Dart went 32.6 for KevinVang, which is an absurd sentence to type, and Kenneth Walker matched him at 32.6 for Hvang94. D'Andre Swift dropped 31.9 on Tub89's behalf and Jahmyr Gibbs added 31.1 for YMVtheDAD. cvang1990 didn't even need a monster — Lamar Jackson 27.0, Chuba Hubbard 22.2, and Isaiah Likely quietly going 23.8 at tight end added up to a league-best 131.31.

Special mention to Isaiah Likely and Dallas Goedert (21.7) for outscoring Travis Kelce (8.6), George Kittle (2.2) and Brock Bowers (0.0, benched, which was somehow correct) combined. The tight end position is in shambles and we love to see it. 💀

sections.heading: THE BENCH HALL OF SHAME 🪑
sections.body:
Keeneng owns the deed to this section forever, but he has company. VangMushu started Drake Maye (11.8) over Jayden Daniels (21.7) and then lost by 45.04, the week's biggest beatdown — not that ten extra points would have mattered, but it's the principle. jayvang100 left Brock Purdy and his 27.1 on the pine to start Dak Prescott's 18.4, then lost by 22.81. Nine points short of nothing.

ChunckyM deserves his own paragraph. He benched Parker Washington (16.8) AND Matthew Golden (12.5) — 29.3 points of receiver — while starting Jaylen Waddle for 0.7 and Darren Waller for 3.8. He lost by 9.25. Every single one of those calls was individually fatal. That takes real commitment. 👏

Tonglue got the artful version: Jalen Hurts goes 30.7, and DarkHado still manages 88.27 because A.J. Brown gave him 4.1, the Broncos defense gave him 0.7, and Caleb Douglas (11.9), Jakobi Meyers (11.2) and Brenton Strange (9.3) all watched from the couch. And mouavang86 benched Jalen Coker's 29.8 — the biggest bench score in the league that didn't belong to Keeneng — and won anyway. Some people are just built different. 😎

sections.heading: NOT GOOD, JUST LUCKY (ACCURATE) ✅
sections.body:
Hvang94's team is literally named Not good, Just lucky and Week 1 was a documentary. Kyler Murray posted NEGATIVE 0.4. The Packers defense contributed 0.1. That is two starting slots producing a combined negative three-tenths of a point, and Hvang94 won anyway, 126.12 to 114.54, because Kenneth Walker (32.6), Amon-Ra St. Brown (23.7), Dallas Goedert (21.7) and Evan McPherson (19.0) refused to let the ship sink. 🚢

On the other side, imbackbeech scored 114.54 — the fifth-highest total in a fourteen-team league — and is 0-1. Christian Watson went off for 29.7, Javonte Williams added 21.7, and it all got torched by Ja'Marr Chase putting up 2.2 and the Texans defense actively costing him 2.6 points. The Two-Minute Cumback Kingz had the cumback in them and ran out of schedule. 😤

While we're here: negative defenses were a whole genre this week. Chargers -2.9 for YMVtheDAD, Texans -2.6, Rams -1.2 for Evz132. Three managers paid a roster spot for the privilege of being subtracted from.

sections.heading: WAIVER WATCH 📋
sections.body:
ChunckyM filed eleven of the league's thirty-one transactions and the ledger is a tragedy in three acts: dropped Trevor Lawrence for Cameron Dicker, dropped Cameron Dicker for Darren Waller, re-signed Cameron Dicker two days later. Dicker scored 2.0. Waller scored 3.8. Lawrence scored 34.1 in someone else's press box. Eleven moves, one loss, and the Raiders defense bouncing in and out of the roster like it was renting month-to-month. 😂

The quiet winner is YMVtheDAD, who grabbed Cairo Santos off the wire on September 7 and got a clean 12.0 out of him in a 22.81-point win — and then added Dontayvion Wicks two days before kickoff, who promptly went 14.3 from the bench. Hvang94 picked up Devaughn Vele on the 9th for 16.4, also benched. Half this league's best waiver adds spent Sunday in street clothes.

Honorable mention to Tonglue, who added Caleb Douglas on August 28, watched him score 11.9, and lost by 43.04 anyway. Timing is everything and nobody here has any. ⏰

sections.heading: STANDINGS, SUCH AS THEY ARE 📊
sections.body:
cvang1990's UnderDogStyle sits on top at 1-0 with 131.31, followed by Evz132 (126.84), Hvang94 (126.12) and Tub89 (126.01) — four teams within five points of each other, all winners. mouavang86 snuck in at 109.06, the lowest winning score of the week, which in this league counts as elite game management.

At the bottom, VangMushu's I Chase Brown Kids managed 80.97 and got run over by 45 in the week's worst loss. Chase Brown did give him 16.3, so at least the team name is holding up its end.

Everybody's 1-0 or 0-1 and nobody has learned anything yet. Sixteen weeks to go. Start your good players. 🤡
